subject: Golden Buddha
hook: GOLDEN BUDDHA IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK
angle: The Golden Buddha isn’t a single solid casting – it’s assembled from multiple sections (ten interlocking parts) rather than one monolithic piece
angle_support: "When all the plaster was removed, it was found that the gold statue actually consisted of ten parts that fit smoothly together." (Wikipedia, Discovery of the golden statue)

"Due to its immense size, the statue was cast in nine separate sections—including the head, the torso, the lap, and three pieces for each arm—allowing it to be completely disassembled." (Wikipedia, Characteristics)
title: Golden Buddha: Ten Interlocking Pieces, Not One Solid Statue
description: The famed Golden Buddha isn’t a single block of gold. It’s made of ten precisely fitted sections, a clever solution for moving the 5.5‑tonne icon.
narration: GOLDEN BUDDHA IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You picture the Golden Buddha as one massive solid casting. It was actually built from ten interlocking sections that fit together like a puzzle of gold today. During the 1955 unveiling, the plaster cracked and revealed ten interlocking gold pieces, each precisely fitted, with a concealed key at the base. The sections—head, torso, lap, and three arm pieces—made transport possible for future use. The myth shattered—this Buddha is a ten‑piece golden puzzle of art
